2. Heard Sri R.P. Rajan, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Arvind Kumar, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

3. This application under Section 529 BNSS has been filed by the applicant Vijay Jaiswal with the prayer to direct the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.IV/Special Magistrate M.P./M.L.A., Varanasi to decide the application dated 30.09.2024 moved by applicant in Criminal Case No. 1202 of 2011 (arising out of Case Crime No. 558 of 2010), under Sections 419, 420, 467,
468, 469, 471, 120-B IPC, P.S. Cantt, District Varanasi within such period of time.

entities.text: Vijay Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is accused in this case.

While placing para 5 of the affidavit it is submitted that the applicant has moved an application dated 30.09.2024 before Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.IV/Special Magistrate M.P./M.L.A., Varanasi with a prayer to permit the accused/applicant to apply for renewal of his passport before the passport authority.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.IV/Special Magistrate M.P./M.L.A., Varanasi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The said application is still pending and has not yet been decided.

5. Learned counsel for the State states that no useful purpose would be served in issuing notice to opposite party and keeping this application pending before this Court and it may be disposed of at this stage itself.

6. Considering the limited grievance of learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.IV/Special Magistrate M.P./M.L.A., Varanasi is directed to make an endeavour to decide the aforesaid application dated 30.09.2024, as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of three weeks from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before it, if there is no legal impediment.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.IV/Special Magistrate M.P./M.L.A., Varanasi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. With the aforesaid directions, this application is disposed of.
